# Physics-based Wide-Spectrum Generalization of Cardiac MRI segmentation
This repository implments physics-based cardiac MRI augmentation techniques for a wide-spectrum generalzation of cardiac MRI segmentation models.

## 0. Installation 
```bash
pip install -e .
```

Set up the environmental variables:
```bash
export nnUNet_raw_data_base="/path/to/nnunetdata/raw"
export nnUNet_preprocessed="/path/to/nnunetdata/preprocessed"
export RESULTS_FOLDER="/path/to/nnunetdata/results"
```
